meta.foldRule: The grammar tier folds into ledger notes only if, on the stated-colour rows, at least 5 agree with the colour map and the count exceeds the majority-colour baseline; otherwise its sentences stay in the sidecar as model-tier, unchecked. A reader-inferred colour is never a score.

slugs.time-stop: PR1 freeze the world with a cooldown equal to its length; ability_records.js has fixed-minute cooldowns, no world freeze
slugs.time-loop: PR2-PR3 one save, set by a held stop, reload on real death; anchor_snapshots.js branches a world at anchors, it does not restore a body on death
slugs.memory-transfer: PR4 a consented, unbroken chain carries memory across a reset
slugs.source-link: PR7-PR8 a power drawn from a colour dimension through Flux that a canceller can cut
slugs.bond-slots: PR5 one Elixir per body, a second makes a Psycho
slugs.body-code-decay: Psycho condition, code decay and sterility
slugs.anti-power-site: PR9 a site that blocks named effects (Monaco)
slugs.mind-binding: a power that binds or rewrites another mind (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.area-field: an effect that holds over an area and not a target (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.power-interaction: a power that answers another power (cancel, immunity, counter; shared slug, PWC5)
